title: derm secrets' projects
description: ~/.derm/secret-projects.json (step P, lane PB's I-4; P integration, 22 Nov 2026, request PB-3): which projects' chats each secret of secrets.json is for. A chat of a project gets the secrets bound to it and no others; a chat in no project gets only the secrets bound to none. Written only by `derm secret add --project`, `bind` and `unbind` from a terminal; owner-only, as secrets.json. The reference is crates/derm-egress/src/bind.rs (`Bindings::check`).
